tagline.zh: M3 官方六组缓动-时长配对:Emphasized 500ms(屏内起止)/ Emph-decel 400ms(进入)/ Emph-accel 200ms(永久退出)/ Standard 300ms(屏内起止)/ Std-decel 250ms(进入)/ Std-accel 200ms(退出),按过场类型直接查表选型。
tagline.en: M3's six official easing-duration pairs: Emphasized 500ms (both ends on-screen) / Emph-decel 400ms (enter) / Emph-accel 200ms (permanent exit) / Standard 300ms (both ends on-screen) / Std-decel 250ms (enter) / Std-accel 200ms (exit) — a lookup table keyed by transition type.

origin.zh: M3《Applying easing and duration》官方配对表(Jina 实抓,调研 04§1.4):Emphasized 500 / Emphasized decelerate 400 / Emphasized accelerate 200 / Standard 300 / Standard decelerate 250 / Standard accelerate 200(ms)。CSS 数值取 tokens-specs 页:emph-decel cubic-bezier(0.05,0.7,0.1,1)、emph-accel cubic-bezier(0.3,0,0.8,0.15)、standard cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1)、std-decel cubic-bezier(0,0,0,1)、std-accel cubic-bezier(0.3,0,1,1);Emphasized 本体在 CSS 无等价贝塞尔(官方标注 N/A,以 Standard 兜底;Android 用多段 pathInterpolator 实现)。
origin.en: The official pairing table from M3's "Applying easing and duration" (fetched via Jina, research 04 §1.4): Emphasized 500 / Emphasized decelerate 400 / Emphasized accelerate 200 / Standard 300 / Standard decelerate 250 / Standard accelerate 200 (ms). CSS values from the tokens-specs page: emph-decel cubic-bezier(0.05,0.7,0.1,1), emph-accel cubic-bezier(0.3,0,0.8,0.15), standard cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), std-decel cubic-bezier(0,0,0,1), std-accel cubic-bezier(0.3,0,1,1); Emphasized itself has no CSS bezier equivalent (officially N/A, Standard as fallback; Android implements it with a multi-segment pathInterpolator).

effect.zh: 六组官方配对(demo 订阅后以该组时长+曲线重播滑块)。语义:屏内起止→Emphasized(快起缓停,大面积)或 Standard(小面积);进入→Decelerate(峰值速度起、缓停);永久退出→Accelerate(静止起、峰值速度止,暗示不可找回);临时退出(drawer/sheet)→Emphasized。
effect.en: The six official pairs (the demo subscribes and replays a slider with that duration + curve). Semantics: on-screen both ends → Emphasized (fast start, gentle stop, large area) or Standard (small area); entering → Decelerate (peaks speed early, settles gently); permanent exit → Accelerate (starts at rest, ends at peak speed, signaling irretrievability); temporary exits (drawer/sheet) → Emphasized.

effect.zh: 采样滑块的水平行程(CSS 变量型)。行程越长,曲线的加速/减速段在视觉上越可辨——同一条 accelerate 曲线在 40px 上几乎读不出「静止起步」,在 200px 上则一目了然。默认 120px 为演示值。
effect.en: Horizontal travel of the sample slider (CSS-variable type). Longer travel makes the curve's acceleration/deceleration visible — the same accelerate curve is unreadable at 40px but obvious at 200px. The 120px default is a demo value.

note.zh: 六组曲线落地全用 CSS cubic-bezier(),属 CSS Easing Functions 既有特性(MDN easing-function 页,调研 04§1.1 实抓),各现代浏览器可用;本次调研未逐浏览器核验版本矩阵。Emphasized 本体官方标注 CSS 无等价(以 Standard 兜底),demo 对 emphasized-500 组同样按官方口径使用 Standard 曲线。
note.en: All six curves land as CSS cubic-bezier(), part of the long-standing CSS Easing Functions (MDN easing-function page, fetched in research 04 §1.1), available in modern browsers; the per-browser version matrix was not audited in this pass. Emphasized itself is officially without a CSS equivalent (Standard fallback) — the demo follows that for the emphasized-500 pair too.

fallback.zh: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce 时过场直出终态,不播放位移;功能与信息不损失。曲线层面:Emphasized 无 CSS 等价贝塞尔,降级即官方兜底方案 Standard cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1);需要更贴近官方曲线时,Android 侧用多段 pathInterpolator(0.05,0 … 1,1)。
fallback.en: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, transitions render the final state directly without displacement; function and information are unaffected. For curves: Emphasized has no CSS bezier, so the fallback is officially Standard cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); Android gets closer to the official curve with a multi-segment pathInterpolator (0.05,0 … 1,1).

use.zh: 进入屏幕的元素:Decelerate 族(峰值速度起、缓停)——Std-decel 250ms 小件 / Emph-decel 400ms 大件
use.en: Elements entering the screen: the Decelerate family (peak speed early, gentle stop) — Std-decel 250ms for small items / Emph-decel 400ms for large

use.zh: 永久退出屏幕的元素:Accelerate 族(静止起、峰值速度止)200ms——官方语义「暗示不可找回」
use.en: Elements permanently leaving the screen: the Accelerate family (rest to peak speed) at 200ms — officially "signals it cannot be recalled"

use.zh: 屏内起止的转场:大面积 Emphasized 500ms、小面积 Standard 300ms
use.en: Transitions with both ends on-screen: Emphasized 500ms for large areas, Standard 300ms for small

use.zh: 临时退出(drawer/sheet 停在屏缘,暗示可召回):官方指定 Emphasized
use.en: Temporary exits (drawer/sheet parked at the screen edge, recallable): officially Emphasized

avoid.zh: 永久退出误用 Decelerate——缓停的收尾暗示「还会回来」,与「已删除」矛盾
avoid.en: Decelerate on permanent exits — the gentle stop implies "it will come back", contradicting deletion

avoid.zh: 进入误用 Accelerate——从静止加速进入让新内容显得被甩进来,且收尾生硬
avoid.en: Accelerate on entrances — accelerating in from rest makes new content look flung in with a harsh landing

avoid.zh: 把 Emphasized 硬凑成单段贝塞尔还声称「官方曲线」——官方明确标注 CSS 无等价,只能 Standard 兜底或多段逼近
avoid.en: Faking Emphasized with a single cubic-bezier while claiming it is "the official curve" — officially N/A in CSS; only Standard fallback or multi-segment approximation

avoid.zh: 高频控件叠加 500ms 大曲线——HIG:高频交互避免加动效(调研 04§1.6)
avoid.en: Stacking a 500ms curve on high-frequency controls — HIG: avoid motion on frequent interactions (research 04 §1.6)

a11y.zh: 配对表不豁免 prefers-reduced-motion:reduce 时位移过场直出终态(MDN 前庭安全);Accelerate「不可找回」的语义不能只靠动效传达,需配视觉状态变化;动效不得是关键信息唯一渠道(HIG:可辅以 haptics/音频,可取消)。
a11y.en: The pairing table never waives prefers-reduced-motion: under reduce, displacement transitions render the final state (MDN vestibular safety); the Accelerate "irretrievable" meaning must not ride on motion alone — pair it with visual state changes; motion is never the sole channel for key information (HIG: complement with haptics/audio, keep cancellable).

goal.zh: 按 M3 官方配对表为一批转场选型:屏内起止取 Emphasized 500ms(大面积)或 Standard 300ms,进入取 Decelerate 400/250ms,永久退出取 Accelerate 200ms;CSS 侧用官方贝塞尔值(cubic-bezier(0.05,0.7,0.1,1) 等),Emphasized 用 Standard 兜底。
goal.en: Select transitions per M3's official pairing table: both ends on-screen take Emphasized 500ms (large) or Standard 300ms, entrances take Decelerate 400/250ms, permanent exits take Accelerate 200ms; in CSS use the official bezier values (cubic-bezier(0.05,0.7,0.1,1) etc.) with Standard as the Emphasized fallback.

acceptance.en: Pair durations come strictly from the official table (500/400/200/300/250/200ms)

acceptance.zh: 曲线值逐字取官方 CSS 标注:std cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1)、std-decel (0,0,0,1)、std-accel (0.3,0,1,1)、emph-decel (0.05,0.7,0.1,1)、emph-accel (0.3,0,0.8,0.15)
acceptance.en: Curve values match the official CSS notes verbatim: std cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), std-decel (0,0,0,1), std-accel (0.3,0,1,1), emph-decel (0.05,0.7,0.1,1), emph-accel (0.3,0,0.8,0.15)

acceptance.zh: Emphasized 组不伪造单段「官方曲线」,按官方口径以 Standard 兜底并注明
acceptance.en: The Emphasized pair is not faked with a single "official" bezier — Standard fallback per official guidance, with a note

acceptance.zh: 过场类型与曲线语义一致:进入 decel、永久退出 accel、临时退出 emphasized
acceptance.en: Transition type matches curve semantics: enter decel, permanent exit accel, temporary exit emphasized

acceptance.zh: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce 时直出终态,不播位移过场
acceptance.en: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, render the final state directly without playing displacement transitions
